derived_current_contracts: SELF_MODIFICATION_IS_CANDIDATE_ONLY: generation never grants execution/installation authority.
REVERSIBLE_PIPELINE_DEACTIVATION: if a candidate generator collapses into garbage, disable the faulty lane while preserving evidence/code for diagnosis rather than forcing it into production.
WORLD_REFERENCE_RESOLUTION: generated room/entity/world references must resolve against authoritative registered state before they can influence cognition or action.
HYPOTHESIS_RELEVANCE_GATE: an observation/thought may update a hypothesis only with explicit semantic relevance evidence; unrelated text must not close hypotheses.
RECURSIVE_COGNITION_BUDGET: reflections/AURA/idle thought loops require rate limits, dedup, fixation detection and outward-diversion behavior.
COUPLING_TESTS_OVER_COMPONENT_TESTS: reward, thalamus, workspace and persistence paths need end-to-end propagation oracles because locally alive components can still be functionally disconnected.
BUILD_REPRODUCIBILITY_IS_SUPPORT_EVIDENCE: reproducible container/CI construction is mandatory harness infrastructure but cannot substitute for behavioral semantic tests.
